en.title: National Museum of China: Booking and a Focused Route
en.headline: How to Visit the National Museum of China Without Losing the Day
en.description: Reserve with the correct document, enter through the North Gate and build a focused two-to-four-hour route through China's enormous national museum.
en.heroAlt: The west facade of the National Museum of China facing Tiananmen Square in Beijing
en.featuredLinkLabel: Plan a focused National Museum visit
